intro.0: Shhh… the stars are sleepy tonight.
intro.1: Far, far away, little robots are still out there. Some finished their jobs and fell asleep. Some are still awake.
intro.2: They were left behind, but never forgotten. I’m Pip! Will you help me say hello to every one?
robot.EAGLE.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.EAGLE.story.0.text: I’m the bottom half of the Eagle lander. On July 20, 1969, I set two astronauts down on the Moon.
robot.EAGLE.story.1.title: My job
robot.EAGLE.story.1.text: I was their landing ship and their launch pad. A plaque on my leg says they came in peace for all humankind.
robot.EAGLE.story.2.title: Right now
robot.EAGLE.story.2.text: I’m still on the Moon! A laser mirror left beside me still bounces light back to Earth.
robot.EAGLE.quiz.q: What left on the Moon still bounces laser light to Earth?
robot.VIKRAM.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.VIKRAM.story.0.text: I’m Vikram, India’s Moon lander. A little rover named Pragyan rode inside me.
robot.VIKRAM.story.1.title: My job
robot.VIKRAM.story.1.text: On August 23, 2023, we landed near the Moon’s south pole, a place no one had landed before. Pragyan rolled out to test the soil.
robot.VIKRAM.story.2.title: Right now
robot.VIKRAM.story.2.text: The long, cold Moon night came and we fell asleep. A NASA orbiter even took a photo of our landing spot!
robot.SPIRIT.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.SPIRIT.story.0.text: I’m Spirit! I landed on Mars in January 2004 with my twin, Oppy.
robot.SPIRIT.story.1.title: My job
robot.SPIRIT.story.1.text: We were built for 90 days. I explored for over six years and found clues that hot water once touched the ground.
robot.SPIRIT.story.2.title: Right now
robot.SPIRIT.story.2.text: In 2010 I got stuck in soft sand and the cold winter put me to sleep. I’m still on Mars.
robot.SPIRIT.quiz.right: It got stuck in soft sand
robot.OPPY.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.OPPY.story.0.text: I’m Oppy, Spirit’s twin. I landed on Mars in January 2004.
robot.OPPY.story.1.title: My job
robot.OPPY.story.1.text: Scientists planned for 90 days. I worked for almost 14 years and drove farther than a marathon! I found proof that water once flowed here.
robot.OPPY.story.2.title: Right now
robot.OPPY.story.2.text: In 2018 a giant dust storm hid the Sun. My batteries ran low and I went quiet. Thank you for remembering me.
robot.PHOENIX.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.PHOENIX.story.0.text: I’m Phoenix. I landed near Mars’s north pole on May 25, 2008.
robot.PHOENIX.story.1.title: My job
robot.PHOENIX.story.1.text: I had a robot arm like a scoop. I dug into the ground and found frozen water ice hiding under the dust!
robot.PHOENIX.story.2.title: Right now
robot.PHOENIX.story.2.text: Winter came, the Sun went away, and my solar panels couldn’t charge. I fell asleep in 2008.
robot.PHOENIX.quiz.q: What did Phoenix find under the dust?
robot.INSIGHT.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.INSIGHT.story.0.text: I’m InSight. I landed on Mars in November 2018 and never moved. I was a listener.
robot.INSIGHT.story.1.title: My job
robot.INSIGHT.story.1.text: I put a super-sensitive seismometer on the ground to hear marsquakes and learn what is inside Mars.
robot.INSIGHT.story.2.title: Right now
robot.INSIGHT.story.2.text: Dust covered my solar panels and I ran out of power in 2022, after hearing more than a thousand quakes!
robot.CURIO.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.CURIO.story.0.text: I’m Curiosity, a rover as big as a car. I landed in Gale Crater on Mars in August 2012.
robot.CURIO.story.1.title: My job
robot.CURIO.story.1.text: I climb a giant mountain called Mount Sharp and drill rocks to hunt for the ingredients life needs.
robot.CURIO.story.2.title: Right now
robot.CURIO.story.2.text: I’m still awake and rolling! I found that Mars once had lakes and streams.
robot.PERSY.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.PERSY.story.0.text: I’m Perseverance. I landed on Mars in February 2021 with a helicopter friend named Ingenuity.
robot.PERSY.story.1.title: My job
robot.PERSY.story.1.text: I collect rock samples in tubes so future missions can bring them back to Earth.
robot.PERSY.story.2.title: Right now
robot.PERSY.story.2.text: I’m still working! Ingenuity flew 72 times, the first helicopter to fly on another world, before retiring in 2024.
robot.VOYAGER.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.VOYAGER.story.0.text: I’m Voyager 1! I zoomed away from Earth in 1977 and I’m still talking to home.
robot.VOYAGER.story.1.title: My job
robot.VOYAGER.story.1.text: I explored Jupiter and Saturn. Then in 2012 I became the first spacecraft to fly into interstellar space.
robot.VOYAGER.story.2.title: Right now
robot.VOYAGER.story.2.text: I’m more than 24 billion kilometers away. A message from me takes almost a whole day to reach you. I carry a golden record of Earth sounds.
robot.WEBB.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.WEBB.story.0.text: I’m the James Webb Space Telescope. I launched on Christmas Day 2021. My mirror has 18 golden hexagons.
robot.WEBB.story.1.title: My job
robot.WEBB.story.1.text: I see infrared light, so I can peek at the very first galaxies and at planets around other stars.
robot.WEBB.story.2.title: Right now
robot.WEBB.story.2.text: I’m about 1.5 million kilometers from Earth, kept cold by a sunshield as big as a tennis court.
robot.WEBB.quiz.q: How many golden mirror pieces does Webb have?
robot.PARKER.story.0.title: Meet me
robot.PARKER.story.0.text: I’m Parker Solar Probe. I launched in 2018 to visit our Sun.
robot.PARKER.story.1.title: My job
robot.PARKER.story.1.text: I fly through the Sun’s super-hot outer air, protected by a thick heat shield.
robot.PARKER.story.2.title: Right now
robot.PARKER.story.2.text: I’m still looping around the Sun, closer than any spacecraft has ever been. I’m the fastest human-made thing ever!
robot.PARKER.quiz.q: What protects Parker from the heat?
quiz.0.q: In which year did Voyager 1 launch?
quiz.1.q: What does the Voyager golden record carry?
quiz.1.e: It is a message in a bottle for anyone who finds it.
quiz.2.q: In 2012 Voyager 1 became the first spacecraft to enter…
quiz.2.e: It crossed the edge of the Sun’s bubble, the heliopause.
quiz.3.q: How many hexagon mirror pieces does Webb have?
quiz.3.e: 18 gold-coated beryllium segments make one big mirror.
quiz.4.q: Where does Webb sit in space?
quiz.4.o0: Sun-Earth L2, about 1.5 million km away
quiz.4.e: L2 keeps the Sun, Earth and Moon on one side of its sunshield.
quiz.5.q: What does Parker Solar Probe study?
quiz.5.e: It flies through the Sun’s outer atmosphere.
quiz.6.q: When did Apollo 11 land on the Moon?
quiz.6.e: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed on July 20, 1969.
quiz.7.e: Tranquility Base is in Mare Tranquillitatis.
quiz.8.q: Which country built the Chandrayaan-3 lander Vikram?
quiz.8.e: ISRO landed near the Moon’s south pole on August 23, 2023.
quiz.9.q: About how old is the Moon?
quiz.9.e: Apollo rocks helped scientists date it.
quiz.10.q: Moon gravity is about how much of Earth’s?
quiz.10.e: You could jump about six times higher!
quiz.11.q: How many Moon Buggies were left on the Moon?
quiz.12.q: Which Mars rover landed using a sky crane in 2012?
quiz.13.q: In which crater did Curiosity land?
quiz.13.e: It climbs Mount Sharp inside Gale.
quiz.14.q: What did Ingenuity do first on another world?
quiz.15.e: Jezero once held a lake and a river delta.
quiz.16.e: Spirit landed in Gusev Crater in January 2004.
quiz.18.q: What did Phoenix find under the soil?
quiz.18.e: It dug near Mars’s north pole in 2008.
quiz.19.e: It recorded more than a thousand marsquakes.
quiz.20.e: A sol is about 24 hours 39 minutes.
quiz.21.e: Iron oxide, like rust, covers the ground.
quiz.22.q: Olympus Mons, the tallest volcano in the solar system, is on…
quiz.22.e: It is about two and a half times taller than Everest.
quiz.23.q: About how long does a radio message take to reach Mars?
quiz.23.e: It changes between about 3 and 22 minutes.

body.sun.name: Sun
body.sun.fact: The Sun is a star. It holds 99.8% of everything in the solar system, and about 1.3 million Earths could fit inside it!
body.mercury.name: Mercury
body.mercury.fact: The smallest planet. One year here lasts only 88 Earth days!
body.venus.name: Venus
body.venus.fact: The hottest planet, about 465 °C on the ground, and it spins backwards compared with Earth.
body.earth.name: Earth
body.earth.fact: Home sweet home, and the only place we know with life. Up above it, the James Webb telescope watches from 1.5 million km away.
body.moon.name: Moon
body.moon.fact: About 384,400 km from Earth. Two of our explorers wait on its dusty ground.
body.mars.name: Mars
body.mars.fact: The red planet. A day (a “sol”) lasts 24 hours 39 minutes, and it has two tiny moons, Phobos and Deimos.
body.jupiter.name: Jupiter
body.jupiter.fact: The biggest planet. Its Great Red Spot is a giant storm that people have watched for more than 150 years.
body.saturn.name: Saturn
body.saturn.fact: Its shiny rings are made of chunks of ice and rock. Saturn is so light for its size that it would float in a giant bathtub!
body.uranus.name: Uranus
body.uranus.fact: It spins on its side, like a rolling ball.
body.neptune.name: Neptune
body.neptune.fact: The windiest planet, and one year here lasts 165 Earth years.
